why: Details the exact click paths for installing Google Analytics 4 via Google Tag Manager, creating custom event parameters (like menu link clicks), and explicitly identifies the 5 mandatory GA4 admin settings (including extending session timeouts and data retention) required for accurate e-commerce tracking.

event contracts / configuring custom events via Google Tag Manager (GTM), setting trigger conditions (e.g., Click Classes contains), mapping custom parameters (like menu_item_name and menu_item_url), and registering those parameters as Custom Dimensions in the GA4 admin panel. The requirement to use lowercase letters and underscores for GA4 event names. adjusting GA4 settings / the five mandatory admin configurations for new GA4 properties: 1) extending data retention from 2 months to 14 months, 2) configuring cross-domain tracking under tag settings, 3) defining and filtering internal office IP traffic, 4) extending default session timeouts from 30 minutes to up to 7 hours and 55 minutes to prevent fragmented sessions, and 5) enabling Google Signals for demographic data (age, gender, interests). using explorations / building Free Form tables and Path Explorations, including the ability to reverse-engineer user journeys by selecting "Purchase" as the end-point and working backward to identify friction.

The rule for multi-site properties: if visitors jump between multiple domains in a single user journey (e.g., a main site and a dedicated checkout domain), use one single GA4 property and configure cross-domain tracking in the data stream settings. The specific GTM preview mode testing sequence: connect to the site, trigger the event, verify the tag fired in GTM, then use GA4's DebugView to confirm the parameters were received before publishing the container. The specific instruction to extend the "engaged session" threshold from the default 10 seconds to at least 30 seconds. The warning that GA4 takes 24 to 48 hours to fully process event data, meaning new custom dimensions will not appear in standard reports immediately.
